text:
alex: heads up — since ~03:10 UTC we're seeing P99 latency SLO misses in us-west-2 on the large text-generation fleet. graphs look like rhythmic spikes, not a single outage.
maria: seeing the same. p99 oscillates between ~220ms and ~480ms every ~30-90s. prefills seem to pile up.
jonathan: stack traces point to admission throttling + max-batch hitting hard. queue depth jumps, then admission drops which dumps more small requests into tail.
keshav: can you paste the admission/limiter metrics? curious about refill vs burst.
alex: copy of the short window dump: 
```
admission.tokens.available: 12->0->14 pattern
max_batch_tokens: 4096
inflight.requests: 178 -> 210 -> 145
latency.p99: 220ms -> 480ms -> 190ms
prefill.queue: 340 -> 710 -> 290
```
ingrid: that looks like regulator oscillation — the leaky-bucket refill is too coarse for current arrival pattern. when batches fill, we hard-stop admission, causing a cold burst of small single-call requests which then re-saturate packing.
maria: region note — this is concentrated on us-west-2-eu-fallback shard set (we're routing some traffic there after eu capacity change). could be packing mix mismatch.
jonathan: interesting, when max_batch gets saturated the packer waits longer for fill, so prefill backlog grows. then the admission controller clamps throughput to protect GPU. it recovers, we flush, and repeat. bad feedback loop.
keshav: quick mitigation options: 1) reduce max_batch_tokens on affected pool 2) increase refill rate / enable soft-admit smoothing 3) enable temporary per-shard smaller max_batch for this region 4) fallback to smaller model under pressure.
alex: can we A/B #2 vs #3? prefer minimal config churn.
ingrid: #2 (smoothing) is low-risk. we can change `admission.refill_window` from `1s` to `200ms` and add a small jitter. might stop the cliff admissions.
maria: config snippet I tested locally: 
```
admission:
  refill_window: 200ms
  refill_jitter_pct: 10
  max_inflight: 250
  max_batch_tokens: 3584  # soft cap
```
jonathan: does that require deploy? we can push via runtime-config with rollout.
alex: yes runtime-config. @deploy-bot can you do a staged rollout to two us-west-2 pools (shard 12 + 15) with a 5m canary? tag: `qos/regulator-200ms`
deploy-bot: acknowledged. creating rollout: `rtcfg/qos/regulator-200ms` -> shards 12,15 (canary 5m).
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-314 (us-west-2 regulator oscillation). severity: Sev-2.
keshav: also adding an autoscaling headroom task: temporarily allow +10% capacity for next 2 hours to absorb bursts. cost tradeoff but avoids customer-facing errors.
maria: good — while rollout runs, watch `latency.p99`, `prefill.queue`, `admission.tokens` and `packing.wait_ms`. we want to see smoothing not flattening with large tail.
jonathan: logged an experiment: if we lower `max_batch_tokens` to 3200 on that shard, packing efficiency drops ~6% but p99 improves 40% in sim. tradeoff looks worth it for high-customer SLAs.
alex: post-rollout checklist: 1) monitor 30m, 2) if p99 stable decrease soft-cap, 3) schedule followup to test adaptive refill algorithm.
ingrid: noted. I'll open a PR with telemetry dashboards and a runbook snippet.
maria: tagging product/ops so they know we may take short-term capacity hit: @alex @maria please ping sales if any enterprise alerts.
jonathan: final note — this pattern (leaky-bucket + large max-batch) likely repeats on other low-traffic shards that recently got cross-region traffic. recommend fleet scan for similar markers.
alex: agreed. keshav, ingrid — can you sweep the fleet for `prefill.queue > 200` and `admission.tokens.throughput variance > 40%`? add findings to the incident.
keshav: on it — will produce CSV in 10m.
deploy-bot: rollout to shards 12,15 complete (canary green).
alex: initial numbers after canary: p99 reduced from ~420ms -> ~210ms on canary shards, prefill.queue down 60%. good sign. continue rollout.
maria: rolling to remaining us-west-2 pools now. ETA 18m.
sre-bot: INC-2026-314 status update: mitigations deployed, p99 trending down. monitoring.
jonathan: followup proposal: implement adaptive refill that looks at recent pack latency and smooths token refill proportionally. I'll draft design doc.
alex: thanks team. keep incident open until 24h stable. action items: rollout complete, fleet sweep CSV, design doc. :thumbsup:
